name: @lostgradient/terminal
description: Browser terminal component and controller for Corvidae, rendered with the selected terminal engine.

scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings --type-aware --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src scripts browser && bun ../../scripts/check-inherited-key-reads.ts && bun ../../internal/component-tooling/scripts/generate-component-artifacts.ts --package-root . --check
scripts.test:browser: bun ../../scripts/chef/ci-replay.ts isolated -- bun ../../scripts/host-slots.ts --slots=4 -- bun --bun playwright test --config browser/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium --workers=4
scripts.test: TZ=UTC LANG=en_US.UTF-8 bun ../../scripts/bun-test-junit.ts --conditions browser --conditions svelte --parallel=4 --path-ignore-patterns='**/*.slow.test.ts' --path-ignore-patterns='**/*.integration.test.ts' src scripts browser/scripts
scripts.test:renderer: TZ=UTC LANG=en_US.UTF-8 bun ../../scripts/bun-test.ts --conditions browser --conditions svelte --parallel=1 src/lib/components/terminal
scripts.test:input: TZ=UTC LANG=en_US.UTF-8 bun ../../scripts/bun-test.ts --conditions browser --conditions svelte --parallel=1 src/lib/input
scripts.test:transport: TZ=UTC LANG=en_US.UTF-8 bun ../../scripts/bun-test.ts --conditions browser --conditions svelte --parallel=1 src/lib/transport
scripts.test:boundaries: TZ=UTC LANG=en_US.UTF-8 bun ../../scripts/bun-test.ts --conditions browser --conditions svelte --parallel=1 scripts/check-boundaries.integration.test.ts && bun scripts/check-boundaries.ts
scripts.test:coverage: TZ=UTC LANG=en_US.UTF-8 bun ../../scripts/bun-test.ts --conditions browser --conditions svelte --parallel=1 --no-isolate --path-ignore-patterns='**/*.slow.test.ts' --coverage --coverage-reporter=text --coverage-reporter=lcov src scripts
